deploybot: 🚀 Initiating production rollout to us-west-2
- tag: v3.6.0-hotfix.7
- commit: 9f1c3a4
- change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC
- plan: staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with observability gates

alice (eng-release): starting traffic shift now. canaries will be at 5m intervals. monitoring gates enabled.

ben (sre): got it. I'll watch infra metrics and API latency dashboards. alert thresholds set for tail latency and error-rate.

carla (product): quick note — release notes snippet live at https://redwood.at/rel-notes/v3.6.0-hotfix-7. small change to reranking that fixes inline truncation.

dave (oncall): @ben ping me if any spike > 2x baseline or >0.5% error increase. i'll stand by for rollback instruction.

alice (eng-release): canary proceeded to 10% on schedule. no obvious errors in logs. sample traces look clean.

deploybot: canary health checks: PASS
- p95 latency change: +3%
- error rate: 0.03%
- throughput: expected

ben (sre): confirming logs — a handful of 500s from a single host (gw-7). investigating.

alice (eng-release): isolating gw-7 from the pool, re-running canary to 10% again.

ben (sre): after removing gw-7, error rate dropped to baseline. looks like an unrelated infra flake. proceed with next step.

alice (eng-release): shifting to 50% now. will watch for 10m.

ops-bot: Note: pinned runtime variant q4-quant to this rollout to avoid auto-rollback during transient kernel changes.

carla (product): tagging docs and notifying CS.

deploybot: rollout to 50% complete. observability gates: PASS. next step scheduled in 10m -> final 100%.

dave (oncall): LGTM from oncall after quick smoke test. no user-facing errors reported in last 15m.

alice (eng-release): promoting to 100% traffic.

deploybot: ✅ Rollout complete to production (us-west-2)
- final tag: v3.6.0-hotfix.7
- commit: 9f1c3a4
- duration: 22m
- status: SUCCESS

ben (sre): quick health-checks green. removing temporary pin on q4-quant variant in 5m.

ops-bot: Audit event: release.promote user=alice pipeline=rollout tag=v3.6.0-hotfix.7

carla (product): filing a short post-release note in #marketing. cc @support-team

alice (eng-release): thanks team. if anything odd surfaces, we will open a follow-up thread. otherwise closing this rollout.

deploybot: thread closed — rollout finished at 2026-03-20T02:22:57Z
